Chapter 1048: 7 Is My Disciple The Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3

Chapter 1048: Chapter 7 Is My Disciple the Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3

“No—” The purple-haired woman within the Space-Time Grand Array widened her eyes. The Myriad Formation Crystal was unable to stop Lin Yuan, and before a Great Lord-level expert, she had utterly no power to resist.

In an instant, the purple-haired woman fell into Lin Yuan’s right hand, layers upon layers of suppressive forces enveloping her. She could feel her thoughts slowing down.

“You want to suppress and capture me alive?”

The purple-haired woman immediately realized Lin Yuan’s intentions. Without hesitation, she obliterated her own soul and consciousness.

Lin Yuan retracted his right hand, leaving only the corpse of the purple-haired woman. Even her corpse began to disintegrate.

With a mere thought, Lin Yuan summoned the Fierce Sun Divine Fire, which surged forward and burned the corpse to ashes.

“Hmm?”

Just then, a deep purple tear condensed, expanding rapidly to form the figure of a woman clothed in a flowing purple gown.

“Which Great Lord are you?”

The woman in the purple gown was none other than Marquis Purple Dream. She had anticipated danger and left a contingency behind the purple-haired woman, enabling her incarnation to manifest in critical moments.

After the gaunt man Kuang Zhen reported the developments in Qingfen City, Marquis Purple Dream realized something was amiss and immediately prepared to descend.

Unfortunately, she was still one step too late; the purple-haired woman had already perished completely. The events unfolded too quickly for Marquis Purple Dream to intervene.

“Which Great Lord am I?”

Lin Yuan chuckled faintly.

In truth, he wasn’t a Great Lord at all.

Not only was he not a Great Lord, he hadn’t even reached the Dao Realm.

In terms of the essence of his existence, he aligned with the Self-Dao Realm of this source world.

Yet Lin Yuan’s foundation was far too deep, and his methods terrifyingly advanced—especially with his awakening of the Fierce Sun Divine Body. Every motion of his seemed infused with the blazing power of the Fierce Sun Divine Fire, making him indistinguishable from an actual Great Lord.

“I know all the Great Lords of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country who possess the Fierce Sun Divine Body, and you are not among them.”

Marquis Purple Dream shook her head. The number of Great Lords within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country who possessed both the Fierce Sun Divine Body and Great Lord-level strength was exceedingly limited.

“A mere Marquis like yourself—how could you know all the Great Lords of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country?” Lin Yuan said dismissively.

Whether it’s the Fierce Sun Ancient Country or any other Ancient Country, there are bound to be hidden experts in the shadows.

Marquis Purple Dream fell silent at Lin Yuan’s words. Indeed, her lack of knowledge didn’t negate Lin Yuan’s existence.

“This time, I admit defeat on behalf of the Purple Dream Domain. However, that Myriad Formation Crystal is not mine. I ask you to return it, and I am willing to exchange other treasures for it.”

Marquis Purple Dream considered for a moment before speaking.

Knowing that her plan had failed, her primary goal now was to minimize the losses.

The Myriad Formation Crystal was a gift from the capital. If it were lost, Marquis Purple Dream would bear the punishment, compelling her to ask for its return in exchange.

“Who do you think you are? A mere incarnation, yet you dare to negotiate with me?” Lin Yuan’s eyes blazed with Fierce Sun flames. He extended his right hand toward Marquis Purple Dream.

As his hand reached out, it abruptly expanded, shrouding the skies and blocking out the sun. Marquis Purple Dream’s expression shifted drastically as her form dissipated instantly.

She was, after all, merely an incarnation—a form without substance, able to scatter or coalesce at will.

Crash!

The surrounding space-time abruptly contracted, forcing Marquis Purple Dream’s dispersed figure to reform, compelled to confront Lin Yuan’s descending palm.

“I’ll remember you.”

Marquis Purple Dream fixed her gaze on Lin Yuan before shattering beneath the force of his palm.

“Expecting to reclaim the Myriad Formation Crystal without a shred of sincerity? Do you take me for a fool?” Lin Yuan shook his head.

The Myriad Formation Crystal’s value far surpassed ordinary Great Lord-level treasures and weapons. Marquis Purple Dream had attempted to use a mere incarnation to retrieve it?

Lin Yuan was no fool.

Moreover, treasures like the Myriad Formation Crystal were coveted by every Ancient Country. Lin Yuan could simply trade it with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country instead, a far more convenient and straightforward option.

“The Myriad Formation Crystal?”

Lin Yuan turned his hand, revealing a crystalline object within which countless formations circulated faintly.

From this encounter, defeating this group of peak Dao Realm infiltrators in Qingfen City, the Myriad Formation Crystal was Lin Yuan’s greatest gain—along with a collection of other treasures and secret tools.

Since they dared to infiltrate Qingfen City, these experts from the Purple Dream Domain were undoubtedly well-prepared, even bringing a treasure as precious as the Myriad Formation Crystal. Clearly, they didn’t lack other preparations.

…

Not far from Sky Burning Court.

Feng Wanxing’s figure appeared.

“Junior Brother, you mustn’t let anything happen to you.”

Feng Wanxing was deeply anxious; he would rather see a Grand Array core breached than to let anything happen to Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?”

Before he approached, Feng Wanxing noticed space-time coalescing in front of Sky Burning Court. A woman clad in a flowing purple gown stood quietly there.

“Is that Marquis Purple Dream?”

As the eldest disciple of Lord Qingfen, Feng Wanxing was naturally familiar with the Great Lords of opposing domains and instantly recognized her identity.

“As I suspected, the target is Junior Brother.”

Marquis Purple Dream’s appearance outside Sky Burning Court confirmed Feng Wanxing’s suspicions.

For a dignified Great Lord from another domain to appear here, the only possible target was Lin Yuan.

And yet.

What followed.

Feng Wanxing witnessed a sight he would never forget.

Before his eyes, his Junior Brother, standing calmly at the gates of Sky Burning Court, extended his right hand. The hand grew explosively, shrouding the heavens in ancient, primeval majesty.

And Marquis Purple Dream, faced with this monstrous palm, had no means of resistance and was shattered to dust in an instant.

“What?”

Feng Wanxing stared in stunned disbelief.

This was his Junior Brother?

….

City Lord’s Mansion.

Lord Qingfen sat cross-legged, his consciousness trapped in a dream woven by Marquis Purple Dream.

A moment later.

Lord Qingfen’s aura surged, and his eyes snapped open.

“Purple Dream, your dream-weaving leaves much to be desired.”

Lord Qingfen immediately spread out his senses, scanning Qingfen City’s current state. Upon confirming the safety of the twelve Grand Array cores, he turned his gaze to Marquis Purple Dream.

“Hmm?”

Lord Qingfen frowned slightly. The Marquis Purple Dream he now beheld appeared distinctly unsettled, staring straight at him with an inexplicable expression.

This left Lord Qingfen a bit baffled.

You suddenly attacked me, and now you’re wearing this expression?

“Qingfen, what a clever tactic—to have prepared ahead and secretly hidden a Great Lord. Truly impressive, truly cunning.”

After speaking, Marquis Purple Dream dispersed her incarnation voluntarily. This operation had resulted in catastrophic losses for the Purple Dream Domain, and she would likely face punishment from her Ancient Country.

“Clever tactic?”

Lord Qingfen was utterly perplexed.

Prepared ahead?

Hidden a Great Lord?

How did he himself not know?
